meaning:
§ Gederoth = "walls"
a town in the low country of Judah

elsewhere.note: Gederoth, Beth Dagon, Naamah, and Makkedah; sixteen cities with their villages.
The Philistines also had invaded the cities of the lowland, and of the South of Judah, and had taken Beth Shemesh, Aijalon, Gederoth, Soco with its villages…
